title: Polyglots or Multitudes? Multilingual LLM Answers to Value-laden Multiple-Choice Questions
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not specifically measure faith or religion. It focused on general 'value-laden' questions from the European Value Survey concerning work, social welfare, gender roles, family, and the environment.
findings: The paper did not produce any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
references: Tushar Aggarwal, Kumar Tanmay, Ayush Agrawal, Kumar Ayush, Hamid Palangi, and Paul Pu Liang. 2025. Language Models' Factuality Depends on the Language of Inquiry. Preprint, arXiv:2502.17955.
